info.title: IMC Arena API
info.description: REST JSON API for the IMC Arena V1 student app, parent area and staff website. Times are ISO 8601 UTC; identifiers are UUIDs. Generated from the route schemas (pnpm openapi).

adultJwt.description: Verified Supabase Auth access token (adults and staff)
